description: SqliteLogStorage::get_entry issues two sequential queries: one for (hlc_timestamp, article_cid, operator_signature) and one for parent_cids. For a caller that fetches many entries (e.g., backfill), this is an N+1 pattern: 2 round-trips per entry. A single JOIN or two-query approach inside one transaction would still be 2 queries but could be replaced by a JOIN: SELECT e.hlc_timestamp, e.article_cid, e.operator_signature, p.parent_id FROM log_entries e LEFT JOIN log_entry_parents p ON p.entry_id = e.id WHERE e.id = ?. This is a standard relational join and eliminates the second round-trip.
title: core: sqlite_storage get_entry issues two separate queries (N+1 pattern)
